observedFailure: Public slider requests repeatedly waited for the managed application instead of receiving a warm edge response.

rootCause.mechanism: The edge worker expected an older application build and the verified discovery routes returned Cache-Control no-store. Spa requests also used a rotation query that the edge allow-list rejected.

rejectedHypotheses.hypothesis: Slow images are the sole cause.
rejectedHypotheses.reason: The JSON discovery response itself took more than four seconds before image decoding began.
A longer placeholder masks but does not remove origin latency or repeat work.

repair: Admit only allow-listed verified discovery responses to a maximum 30-second edge lease.
Keep refreshing, invalid, error, booking, quote, authenticated and full-search traffic no-store.
Recognize the bounded spa rotation key without weakening the query allow-list.
Pre-activate approaching rails and prioritize only the first two visible images.
Publish the app and edge worker as one build-locked release.
